page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on KVM hypervisor architecture. It is equipped with 72 dedicated vCPUs running on Intel Xeon 8163 processors at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 288.0 GB, establishing a standard memory-to-core allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

This server instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring all persistent storage capabilities to be attached via external block storage devices. Hardware GPU accelerators are not present on this instance type. Network connectivity features a high baseline network throughput of 33 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM configuration presents a balanced execution environment suitable for scale-out parallel computing. With no local storage overhead, resource trade-offs lean entirely toward network-attached storage integration and compute density, making the instance suitable for enterprise backend applications, CI/CD build platforms, web clusters, and general-purpose microservice architectures.
